service.description: An event from the current user, a member of a room that is not archived or encrypted: title (1 to 200 characters), startDate and endDate (it ends after it starts, at most 31 days later and later than now, and starts within two years), timeZone (an IANA zone; the user's by default), allDay (whole days: midnights in that zone), place (up to 300) and description (up to 2,000). A message (send#Message, its body the event in words, content.calEvent {title}) and its ChatCalEvent; the state pushed as an update. threadRootEventSeq, clientRef and roomUrl as send#Message. Out: eventSeq, event (with calEvent), duplicate, reasonCode (encryptedRoom, badEvent, badTime, tooLong).

Internal: the events of these messages of a room, as calEventMap eventSeq to {title, start, end (epoch millis), timeZone, allDay, place, description, revision, cancelled, cancelledDate, ended, createdByUserId, lastChangeEventSeq, going, maybe, no (the counts), answers {going, maybe, no: [userId]}, uid, mine {answer (going, maybe or no), remindMinutes, calendarDate} or null}. shared leaves out mine (the same for every member, as push#Update sends it). The caller has checked access.

The current user's answer to an event of a room they may post in, while it is not cancelled or over: answer going, maybe or no, or empty to take it back (the counts kept, the row locked). remindMinutes (0 to 10,080, with going or maybe) sets or moves a reminder that long before the start (ChatScheduleServices set#Reminder; none when that is less than a minute ahead: reminderSkipped); no reminder, No or a take-back cancels the one the answer made. addToCalendar asks the chat-calendar providers to put the entry, and No or a take-back removes one they put. The reminder and the calendar each run on their own: a failure is logged and answered (reminderFailed, calendarFailed) and the answer stands. The state is pushed as an update. Out: calEvent (with mine), eventUrl (a provider's), reasonCode (notFound, notMember, archived, cancelled, ended, badAnswer, badTime).

A change of an event by its creator (still a member who may post) or a moderator or owner, while it is not cancelled or over, at most 20 times: any of the fields of create#CalEvent, checked the same way; revision + 1. A change of the title, time, place or details posts a change message as the changer (a reply to the event, in its thread, content.calChange {eventSeq, revision, what}); the answers' reminders move with the start (each on its own; one now too near is cancelled); then the chat-calendar providers' change. Out: calEvent, changeEventSeq, reasonCode (notAllowed, cancelled, ended, tooManyChanges and those of create#CalEvent).

Cancel an event, for good: its creator or a moderator or owner. A cancellation message (content.calChange {eventSeq, revision, cancelled}), the answers' pending reminders cancelled, then the chat-calendar providers' cancel. Nothing more when it is cancelled already. Out: calEvent, changeEventSeq, reasonCode.

An event as an .ics file, for one who can read the room (the ICalendar tool): PUBLISH, or CANCEL once cancelled; UID chat-roomId-eventSeq@ the property chat_cal_uid_domain (chat.moqui by default) and SEQUENCE the revision, so a calendar that imports it again updates its entry; the times in the event's zone (TZID), or the days of an all-day event; baseUrl (the server's) makes the message's link its URL. Out: fileText, fileName, contentType, reasonCode (notFound, noIcs).

Internal: an event's message is gone (a redaction, retention, an expiry): the answers' pending reminders cancelled, the chat-calendar providers' cancel when one put an entry, and its rows removed, each part on its own. Nothing when the message is no event. The caller has checked access. Out: forgotten.
